message: MUG 2 is proprietary freeware for Windows x64 and SAP2000 27 / CSiBridge 27. Save your models and close the CSI hosts before completing the new setup. The existing MUG 1 backup remains available; the MUG 2 ZIP contains binaries, not MUG 2 source code.
changelog: New viewer with selectable analysis cases, combined imperfections and verified geometry-copy reports.
Standalone SAP2000 launcher, bilingual guide and manual installation via MUG2Setup.exe.
Requires .NET Framework 4.8 and WebView2 Evergreen. Earlier MUG 1 GPL rights remain unchanged.
